component.name: Remote
component.summary: A Roku remote for your desktop

description.p: A small native GNOME remote for Roku TVs. It finds the TV on your local network and talks to it over the plain HTTP External Control Protocol. No account, no cloud, nothing leaves your network.

ul.li: D-pad, Back, Home, Replay, Search, Options, playback and volume
Press and hold to repeat, like the physical remote
Type into TV search boxes from your keyboard
Launch channels from a grid of their icons
Full keyboard control while the window is focused

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Roku, Inc. "Roku" is a trademark of Roku, Inc.

screenshot.caption: The remote in dark and light mode

description.p: First public release, now called Remote. Saved settings from the earlier private build are picked up automatically.
A busy TV no longer shows as unreachable after launching a channel. Dark by default, with an option to follow the system theme. New app icon.
